lesson: ONE fix, the quality lens's P1 and the remaining t-rns-c4 partial. Round 1 gated the scroll EFFECT on surface === 'page' but left the LOOKUP as document.getElementById(scrollTargetId) (ask-panel.tsx:43), which is document-wide and returns the FIRST match in document order - so if a docked panel precedes the page panel it renders the same id={turn.id} (ask-panel.tsx:89) and the page panel scrolls the docked duplicate. Note the two surfaces are on different routes today (/ask renders surface='page', mis-report-view.tsx:161 renders surface='docked'), so this is defensive rather than currently reachable - fix it anyway, because duplicate DOM ids are invalid and a component reaching into the whole document for its own child is wrong regardless. TWO small changes: (1) give the thread container a ref and resolve the target inside it, threadRef.current?.querySelector('#' + CSS.escape(scrollTargetId)), so a panel can only ever scroll its OWN turn; (2) stop emitting id={turn.id} on the docked surface - only the page panel scrolls, so the document never carries duplicate ids at all. Add a leaf that mounts a docked panel BEFORE a page panel with the same turns and asserts the PAGE panel's element is the one scrolled.
